editorial:
You know that feeling when work is so bad you joke about getting rid of your boss? This movie takes that joke and runs with it. Nick, Kurt, and Dale are three normal guys stuck with terrible bosses, and after a few drinks they decide murder is the answer. The setup is silly but easy to follow, and the friends feel like people you might know. Their bosses are awful in different ways, which keeps the jokes fresh. The tone is loud, fast, and full of bad decisions, so you are laughing at how quickly a dumb idea becomes a real mess. It is not deep, but it is a fun ride.

The cast is the big draw. Jason Bateman, Jason Sudeikis, and Charlie Day have great chemistry, while Kevin Spacey, Colin Farrell, and Jennifer Aniston make the bosses memorable. The pacing stays quick, with plenty of awkward moments and close calls. Some jokes are crude, and a few scenes go too far, but the energy rarely drops. If you like dark workplace comedy, this is a good pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, their murder plan falls apart when they accidentally witness Harken kill his wife. Harken tries to kill them and frame them, but they escape and get help. Police arrest Harken, while Julia is exposed and Bobby is already dead. The friends avoid prison, keep their jobs, and finally get better bosses. Nick, Kurt, and Dale are cleared, and each finally gets a better work situation.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark workplace comedy and chaotic friend groups.
